name: mbti-test
description: MBTI Cognitive Function Test — a free 38-item test (EI/SN/TF/JP + A/T) that an AI agent can complete using static GET endpoints only: fetch questions, answer on a 6-point Likert scale, post answers to a JS-rendered scoring endpoint, receive structured result JSON.

skills.name: MBTI Cognitive Function Test
skills.description: Score a complete 38-item MBTI cognitive-function test and return a typed result with dimension ratios, A/T branch, cognitive function stack and profile links. Entertainment self-assessment, not a clinical instrument.

input.description: 38 Likert answers in question-id order (ids 1-38 from ai/questions.json). 1 = strongly agree, 2 = agree, 3 = slightly agree, 4 = slightly disagree, 5 = disagree, 6 = strongly disagree. Directions (dir) are applied server-side.

output.description: Result JSON: spec_version, mode, type, at, code, name_zh, name_en, stack, ratio{EI,SN,TF,JP,AT}, weak_dims, profile_url_zh, profile_url_en, cite.

endpoints.description: Authoritative specification: scale, 38 questions, algorithm, schema, modes, agent prompt.
Question list: id, dim, dir, en, zh (version 1.0).
Scoring endpoint; returns result JSON as text (and in meta[name=mbti-result]). Optional &lang=zh|en.
One of 16 static type profiles, e.g. intj.json: stack, names, descriptions, profile URLs.
